class.name: SpinePathConstraint
class.brief_description: Stores the current pose for a path constraint.
class.description: Stores the current pose for a path constraint. A path constraint adjusts the rotation, translation, and scale of the constrained bones so they follow a {@link PathAttachment}. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-path-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this path constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_data
method.description: The path constraint's setup pose data.

method.name: get_slot
method.description: The slot whose path attachment will be used to constrain the bones.

members.member: The current path position, spacing, rotation mix, and translation mix values. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
The path constraint pose last applied by the animation state. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
A snapshot of [SpineBonePose] wrappers for the bones modified by this constraint. Each access rebuilds the array; modifying the returned array does not change the constraint's bone collection.
The slot whose path attachment constrains the bones. A new wrapper may be returned on each access. Assigning [code]null[/code] is ignored and does not clear the current slot.
The path constraint's setup pose data. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
Whether this path constraint is applied when the skeleton's world transform is updated.
